purpose: Teach: 思想家/松山/結城/侍/みえる/回戦/移さ/舞台裏

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、思想家、絶対、の本、絶対、社員、絶対、読ませろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to get every staff member reading that philosophy book. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding. Short pause after each major clause. No room for negotiation. Direct eye contact. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、松山、絶対、支店、絶対、業績、絶対、好調です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our Matsuyama branch has been performing exceptionally well. We're grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Formal, measured delivery. Slight bow in the voice. Each point landed clearly, like items checked off a list. Respectful but not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、結城、絶対、地域、絶対、新規出店、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want you to start looking into expanding into the Yuki region. Make it happen.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. The kind of directive that expects competent follow-through. Steady pace. A slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社CMに、本気で、絶対、侍、絶対、衣装、絶対、起用、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're casting a samurai in our next commercial. We'll have that locked in.
lines.style: Efficient, positive. Crisp delivery on the key details. Showing initiative without overselling. Professional confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績、本気で、絶対、みえる、絶対、ようにしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure the numbers are visible. I want to see them.
lines.style: Sharp, economical. No softening. A brief, clean instruction. The voice of someone who doesn't repeat himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、第二、絶対、回戦、絶対、コンペ、絶対、勝ち抜きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We just won the second round of the competition. Things are moving forward.
lines.style: Controlled satisfaction. Delivering good news without inflating it. Steady pace. The note of someone reporting real progress.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社、本気で、絶対、移さ、絶対、れる前、絶対、決済しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Get the settlement done before the headquarters move happens. Don't delay.
lines.style: Urgent but controlled. Slightly faster pace on the deadline detail. The weight of a time-sensitive mandate. No negotiation in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、本気で、絶対、舞台裏、絶対、社員ドキュメンタリー、絶対、撮影、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're filming a behind-the-scenes documentary about the new product launch. We're on schedule.
lines.style: Steady, positive report. Professional enthusiasm without excess. Clear enunciation on the project details. The sound of someone managing multiple initiatives well.
